title: FMCG Sales Officer
summary: An FMCG sales officer is the entry-level field salesperson of a consumer goods company, covering a territory of retail shops through one or more distributors. They visit outlets on a fixed beat plan, book orders, set up displays and report daily to an area sales manager, aiming at monthly secondary sales targets (distributor-to-retailer sales).
dailyDuties: Visit retail outlets on the day's beat plan and book orders
Open new outlets and push new products in the territory
Check distributor stock and help place primary orders
Set up displays and keep brands visible on shelves
Report visits and orders in the SFA app at the end of the day
Track secondary sales against the monthly target with the area manager

skills.expectation: Follow the beat plan and drive secondary sales through retailers
Visit retailers daily, book orders and open new outlets
Spend most of the day in the market meeting shopkeepers
Set up displays and keep brands visible on the shelf
Track competitor activity and retailer feedback in the territory
Keep sales and outlet trackers in Excel
Speak the local language and English with retailers and the distributor
Report orders and visits in the company's SFA app and DMS
Check distributor stock, place primary orders and guide the distributor's salesmen
Plan beats and outlet coverage for the territory
Run trade schemes and promotions for retailers
Follow up on distributor payments and claims
Negotiate display space and order size with retailers
